module origen_184658 #(
    parameter REPLY_WIDTH = 8,
    parameter COMM_WIDTH = 8,
    parameter ADR_WIDTH = 4
) (
    input rst,
    input sdi,
    input sck,
    input sel,
    input [REPLY_WIDTH-1:0] replyData,
    input [3:0] patientBttns,
    output reg replyEn,
    output sdo,
    output reg [COMM_WIDTH-1:0] commData,
    output reg [ADR_WIDTH-1:0] commAdr,
    output reg commReady
);

    reg [3:0] state;
    reg txEn;
    reg [COMM_WIDTH-1:0] commDatReg;
    reg [ADR_WIDTH-1:0] commAdrReg;

    always @(posedge sck or negedge sel) begin
        if (!sel) begin
            case (state)
                4'd0: begin
                    txEn <= sdi;
                    replyEn <= !sdi;
                    state <= 4'd1;
                end
                4'd1: begin
                    commAdrReg[0] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd2;
                end
                4'd2: begin
                    commAdrReg[1] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd3;
                end
                4'd3: begin
                    commAdrReg[2] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd4;
                end
                4'd4: begin
                    commAdrReg[3] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd5;
                end
                4'd5: begin
                    commDatReg[0] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd6;
                end
                4'd6: begin
                    commDatReg[1] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd7;
                end
                4'd7: begin
                    commDatReg[2] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd8;
                end
                4'd8: begin
                    commDatReg[3] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd9;
                end
                4'd9: begin
                    commDatReg[4] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd10;
                end
                4'd10: begin
                    commDatReg[5] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd11;
                end
                4'd11: begin
                    commDatReg[6] <= sdi;
                    state <= 4'd12;
                end
                4'd12: begin
                    commDatReg[7] <= sdi;
                    commData <= commDatReg;
                    commAdr <= commAdrReg;
                    commReady <= 1'b1;
                    state <= 4'd0;
                end
                default: state <= 4'd0;
            endcase
        end else begin
            state <= 4'd0;
            commReady <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

    assign sdo = txEn ? replyData[0] : patientBttns[0];

endmodule
